policies.active_filter: Available unknown non-pick candidates occurring in at least one judge blocker set having no known eligible blocker.
policies.costs: Original candidate costs unchanged. No timing comparisons or population significance tests.
policies.exact_filter: Available unknown candidates returned by the original MaskContext exact-relevance algorithm.
policies.pick_first: All six variants choose the pick first if it is available.
policies.priority: After the common pick-first rule, select uniformly, minimum fixed acquisition cost, or maximum incidence among currently unblocked judges; vary only filter within each paired priority.
policies.randomization: Four original stable_seed(original_seed, tie, instance_id, replicate) seeds; reinitialize Random(seed) for every policy. Fresh uniform choice from sorted tied set at every step, including singleton sets. Common random numbers do not imply identical choices after trajectories diverge.

purpose: Isolate exact relevance filtering from pick-first, cost preference and random tie rules on all existing synthetic cases; separately explain previously reported descriptive policy reversals.
required_outputs: Per-instance/replicate/filter/priority query, cost, nonanswer and outcome rows
Paired per-instance means with cheaper/equal/dearer counts and phase/cost/family strata
Meaningful reachable state frequencies with explicit denominators
Exact equality of active uniform and max-incidence traces to original corresponding benchmark aggregates

retention.include: All original instances, including initial certificates and final unresolved cases; no outcome or performance selection.

state_diagnostics.choice_effect: Record whether exact filtering changes the available best-priority set.
state_diagnostics.frequency: Report strict exact subset of active set as state visits, distinct (instance, known_positive, known_negative, available) states pooled across six variants/four seeds, and affected instances. Duplicate visited states/replicate slots are not independent observations.
state_diagnostics.independent_check: At each visited state compare mask relevance to the independently implemented absorbed-DNF relevance result; hand-check a constructed absorption example with explicit world enumeration.
state_diagnostics.meaningful: Before a query, original terminal checks permit acquisition and the pick is not available, so the filter can affect a choice.

status: Internal design amendment frozen after seeing earlier aggregate results and reviewer requests, before running these matched policies. Not preregistration.

stored_result_analysis.interpretation: Unadjusted, overlapping descriptive strata of a fixed synthetic design, with shared latent draws. No p-values, population uncertainty, causal claims, or performance-driven changes to the main benchmark.
stored_result_analysis.main_comparison: Allen cached round robin minus cheapest relevance on all 512 heterogeneous factorial cases, averaging each policy over its four stored tie slots.
stored_result_analysis.reversal_comparison: Allen cached round robin minus pick-first maximum blockers on the 32 constructed unit-cost coverage-negative cases.
stored_result_analysis.status: Posthoc descriptive analysis of existing extension results; factors and representative selection specified here before generating this report, not before original results were observed.
stored_result_analysis.trace_selection: Within each stated group, choose lexicographically smallest case whose per-case mean difference has the requested sign; choose lowest replicate index whose paired difference has that sign. Include one Allen-cheaper and one Allen-dearer factorial heterogeneous case and one Allen-dearer unit coverage-negative case.

terminal_contract: Original classify/can_certify_with stopping; each query paid once; None consumes full cost and remains logically unknown; retain all initial labels and unknown universe.
